title: Brand profile
description: Everything brand-specific the design skills need. The visual tokens live in a separate tokens.json (referenced by `tokens`); this file adds the design language: logo, type rules, voice, color policy, imagery stance.

name.description: Brand / product name as it appears in copy.

tokens.description: Path to the brand's tokens.json (the design-tokens source of truth). Compiled to tokens.css.

logo.description: How the mark/wordmark is built and protected. Logo stays HTML/SVG on top of art — never baked into a generated image.

svgPath.description: Inline SVG path data for the mark, on a stated viewBox.

file.description: Optional raster/SVG file path for a complex logo.

wordmark.description: How to typeset the wordmark in HTML (which word, casing, accent).

lockupRules.description: Never-do rules: no rotate/skew/distort/recolor/bevel/glow, clear-space, co-brand order, etc.

type.description: Typesetting rules. Roles (display/serif/mono) come from tokens; these are the casing/accent conventions.

accentWord.description: e.g. 'exactly one serif-italic accent word, tinted --accent-light' — or 'none'.

lexicon.description: Preferred term → meaning, or banned term → replacement.

semantic.description: Colors allowed ONLY as semantic flags, never decorative.

negatives.description: Always-pass negative prompt items for generated imagery (no text, no people, no second hue, …).
